newsitem.title: USA: Alabama Power files for $400 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: Alabama Power files for $400 mln shelf.

text.p: Alabama Power Co, a unit of Southern Co, said three of its business trusts Thursday filed a shelf registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $400 million in junior subordinated notes and preferred securities.
The three business trusts are Alabama Power Capital Trust II, Alabama Power Capital Trust III and Alabama Power Capital Trust IV.
The trusts will invest the proceeds from the sale of the preferred securities and common securities in an equivalent amount of junior subordinated notes of Alabama Power.

The net proceeds from the investment will be used for its construction program, to pay scheduled maturities, and/or refundings of its securities, repay short-term indebtedness to the extent outstanding and other general corporate purpose.

Alabama Power is a regulated public utility engaged in the generation, transmission, distribution and sale of electric energy within an approximately 44,500 square mile service area comprising most of the state of Alabama.
